ORTHOGONAL POLYNOMIALS (p.783)
Generalized Laguerre Polynomials
22.7.29  L_n^{(\alpha+1)}(x)=\dfrac1x[(x-n)L_n^{(\alpha)}(x)+(\alpha+n)L_{n-1}^{(\alpha)}(x)]
22.7.30  L_n^{(\alpha-1)}(x)=L_n^{(\alpha)}(x)-L_{n-1}^{(\alpha)}(x)
22.7.31  L_n^{(\alpha+1)}(x)=\dfrac1x[(n+\alpha+1)L_n^{(\alpha)}(x)-(n+1)L_{n+1}^{(\alpha)}(x)]
22.7.32  L_n^{(\alpha-1)}(x)=\dfrac1{n+\alpha}[(n+1)L_{n+1}^{(\alpha)}(x)-(n+1-x)L_n^{(\alpha)}(x)]
22.8. Differential Relations
g_2(x)\dfrac{d}{dx}f_n(x)=g_1(x)f_n(x)+g_0(x)f_{n-1}(x)
Columns: f_n | g_2 | g_1 | g_0

22.9. Generating Functions
g(x,z)=\sum_{n=0}^\infty a_nf_n(x)z^n \qquad R=\sqrt{1-2xz+z^2}
